Pricing questions

Common questions about our prices

Do these prices include GST?

Yes. Every price on this page includes GST, so the figure you see is the figure you pay for that engine.

What does "fitted" include?

Fitted means we install the engine in your vehicle at our Hallam, Victoria workshop. It adds a flat $1,000 to the engine-only price on every engine in the table.

What is the difference between new and reconditioned?

A reconditioned engine is rebuilt with OEM-grade parts and restored to factory specification, then tested before release. A new engine is supplied as a new unit. Reconditioned is the more common choice and is the cheaper of the two on every engine we list.

How do I know which engine code my car has?

Send us your rego or VIN and we will match it. Engine codes change between build years and variants, so the vehicle names on this page are a guide rather than a guarantee.

Can you beat a quote I already have?

Yes. Send us an itemised written quote for identical work from a legitimate workshop and we will beat it by five per cent. We do not price against backyard jobs.

My engine is not on the list. Can you still help?

Almost certainly. The table covers our most requested engines across the Hyundai and Kia range. Send us your vehicle details and we will quote your engine directly.
